headline: Lebnitze Real Estates files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for PCBL Chemical
sum: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in PCBL Chemical Limited. The filing signals material shareholding movement triggering mandatory open offer obligations under SEBI Takeover Regulations.
detail: Lebnitze Real Estates Private Limited has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011 to NSE, indicating substantial share acquisition in PCBL Chemical Limited. This disclosure is typically filed after an acquirer crosses a key shareholding threshold (25%, 35%, 45%, 55%, 65%, 75%, 90%). The filing does not yet indicate consideration, number of shares or precise acquirer intent, but confirms the acquisition has progressed beyond preliminary stages and triggers regulatory checkpoints for open offer feasibility and exemption analysis.
